messages:
maya: Heads-up — planning to roll runtime v1.8.3 to prod tonight. Includes observability tweaks (new dashboard panels + temporary trace sampling bump). Target window 21:00 PST. Who can lead the deploy and own post-deploy smoke checks?

aj: I can be deploy lead. 21:00 works for me. What's the exact obsv change list and the smoke/rollback criteria?

maya: Short list: 1) Dashboards: add panel 'model-serving/active-latency-breakdown' and a 90th/99th series on the main serving dash. 2) Tracing: temporarily increase sampling from 1% -> 5% for 15 minutes after each canary step. 3) Alerts: mute the low-severity p95 latency alert for 30m during rollout; adjust 5xx rate alert threshold to 0.5% (was 0.2%) during rollout to reduce noise. We'll revert thresholds automatically at +30m.

lina: For smoke, I suggest this minimal checklist (I'll own telemetry verification):
```
# smoke checklist (to run after canary tilt)
kubectl -n prod rollout status deployment/model-serving -w
curl -sS https://model-serving.prod.internal/health | jq .
# sanity queries in Grafana/Prometheus:
sum(rate(requests_total{job="model-serving",status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(requests_total{job="model-serving"}[5m])) * 100 < 0.5
trace sampling: ensure jaeger shows ~5% sampled for new spans
```

kevin: I'll pre-create the new dashboard panel in the 'Serving' folder and pin the dashboard version so the deploy only toggles visibility. I'll also add a quick link to the trace view. @aj — will you need edit perms on that dash during the window?

aj: Yes please give edit perms to @aj and @lina for 30m. Also who is on-call for pages if anything goes sideways?

maria (typo correction): *sorry* I meant dena will be on escalation.

dena: I'll be escalation + rollback approver. Rollback criteria: sustained 5xx rate > 0.8% for 10 minutes OR p95 latency > 2s above baseline for 10 minutes. If either triggers, we rollback to v1.8.2 and disable the sampling bump.

oncall-bot: Deployment window 'runtime-v1.8.3' scheduled by maya for 2024-07-23 21:00 PST. Watchlist: @aj @lina @kevin @dena. Reminder set for 20:50 PST.

samir: Quick Q — what's the canary ramp plan? 5/25/100 or something slower? Also do we need a DB migration lock?

maya: Canary plan: 5% for 10m, 25% for 15m, then 100% if green. No DB migrations in this release. We will keep a fallback model variant pinned so traffic can be routed to it if we rollback.

aj: Got it. I'll kick off the canary at 21:00. I'll run the smoke checklist at each step and paste the key metrics into this thread. Ping @dena the moment the 5% check looks bad and we'll cut.

lina: I'll validate traces and dashboard panels right after the first tilt. If sampling isn't at ~5% for new spans, I'll call a pause and we revert sampling via feature flag.

kevin: Permissions set for @aj and @lina on the Serving dash (temp). Panel template saved as 'v1.8.3-obsv-snapshot'. :thumbsup:

aj: Cool. I'll post a short post-deploy readout here (latency/p95, 5xx rate, traces sampled) and mark the rollout green or rollback. Thanks all.

maya: Thanks — appreciate the quick turn. See you at 20:55 for the preflight check in the channel. :eyes:
